title: PUK President Bafel Talabani Visits Tehran
text:
PUK President Bafel Talabani Visits Tehran"

"Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei told reporters that Bafel Talabani, President of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) in Iraq’s Kurdistan Region, will visit Tehran on Tuesday."

"According to the Foreign Ministry spokesman, Talabani’s visit is taking place at the invitation of Iran’s foreign minister and falls within the framework of the Islamic Republic of Iran’s ongoing consultations with the Iraqi government and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. The aim is to expand bilateral relations and strengthen peace and stability in the region."

"The Foreign Ministry spokesman stressed that during the visit, the PUK president will meet and exchange views with senior Iranian officials on issues of mutual interest, including economic cooperation and border security.
